description: Greenfield Go scenario replacing legacy scenarios/notification-hub/. Multi-tenant profile system with isolated API keys. Multi-channel delivery: push (via ntfy resource), email (SMTP), SMS, webhook. Device and contact management with per-channel preferences, verification status, and lifecycle states. Template engine with variable substitution and channel-specific content variants. Priority levels (low/normal/high/urgent) mapped to platform notification standards. Rate limiting: per-profile and per-channel with hourly/daily/monthly caps and cost-based limits. DND modes and quiet hours with timezone-aware scheduling. Daily notification caps per device/contact. Notification lifecycle tracking (pending -> queued -> sending -> sent -> delivered/failed) with per-channel delivery logs. Unsubscribe management: per-channel, per-category (marketing vs transactional). CLI for notification management, contact management, and template management. Proto contract in packages/proto/schemas/notification-hub/v1/. Storage: SQLite + file-based. No Postgres, no Redis, no n8n.
name: notification-hub-greenfield-core
title: Build The Greenfield Notification Hub Scenario
